statement: DATO+INFERENZA: a GSK-3 beta S9A knock-in does not prove drug on-target action: S9A removes inhibitory Ser9 control, the ATP-site inhibitor still acted in S21A/S9A muscle, and the methylphenidate paper gives no inhibitor to a knock-in. statement: DATO+INFERENZA: the report's "harm cannot be escaped by isoform selectivity" is not refuted across the board. In HEK293T at one concentration (20 uM, 24 h) neither selective compound raised total or nuclear beta-catenin while the dual compounds including CHIR99021 did, and genetic loss of one isoform does not raise beta-catenin; but the beta-selective BRD3731 raised beta-catenin from 20 uM in HL-60 and TF-1 (alpha-selective BRD0705 induced the reporter only at 60 uM), and cell selectivity was only 4-6-fold. The dissociation therefore holds for the alpha-selective compound, for genetic single-isoform loss, and for both selective compounds only in HEK293T at one concentration. Neural cells untested. The report also offers isoform separation in F004.
